opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text: During the three and nine month periods ended September 30, 2026, we incurred expenses of $9,236 and $25,945 entirely consisting of general and administrative expenses. Our general and administrative expenses primarily consisted of legal and accounting fees, and product development. Initially, a significant portion of our expenses were attributed to one-time legal fees for the preparation of contracts and fees related to the preparation of the registration statement for the public offering of the shares of our common stock.

intro.text: Logoom Technologies, Inc. (“the Company”) was incorporated under the Nevada Business Corporation Act. It is the second fiscal year of the Company. The Company was formed on August 12, 2025 in the Nevada State. The company is built as a SaaS product on AWS infrastructure, the Company unifies log collection, monitoring, and AI-driven analysis into a single, intuitive platform by combining ease of use, scalability, and artificial intelligence to turn raw machine data into actionable insights.
